task-views.local_only: Saved only in this browser for this account, organization and project. No device sync.
task-views.storage_loaded: Latest saved views loaded. Current filters are unchanged.
task-views.storage_corrupt: Saved views are invalid. The original data is retained until you explicitly reset it.
task-views.storage_unavailable: Browser storage is unavailable. The view was not saved; current filters remain usable.
task-views.storage_conflict: Another tab changed saved views. Load the latest list before saving again.
task-views.storage_invalid: Cannot save: check the name and filters. Up to 20 views are allowed.
task-views.name_required: Enter a view name of 1–80 characters.
task-views.recovered: Local views reset. Current filters are unchanged.
task-views.external_change: Another tab changed saved views. Your current filters are retained.
task-views.business_hint: Task business status, execution results and human acceptance are separate facts.
task-views.loaded_scope: Loaded {{loaded}} of {{total}} matching tasks. Total covers the project query.
task-views.no_matches: No tasks match these filters across this project. Adjust or clear the filters.
task-views.name: View name
task-views.delete_description: Delete the local definition of “{{name}}”? Tasks and current filters stay unchanged.
task-views.recover_description: Remove the invalid saved-view data for this account, organization and project? Only local view definitions are reset; tasks are unaffected.
task-views.invalid_filters: The task filters in this link are invalid or too long. No broader query was made. Clear filters to continue.
task-views.query_limit: Up to 200 characters. Longer queries are not silently shortened.
task-views.window_changed: The task list changed while loading another page. Previous results were cleared. Refresh to read from the first page.
task-views.prerequisites_independent: Prerequisite tasks are read from the current project independently of workspace filters.
